insights.topic: Dual signal engines still active — documented divergence, not consolidated
insights.suggestion: Consolidate computeSignals() and StrategyEngine into a single pipeline to eliminate ranking inconsistency between 'Top Signals' and the strategy-aggregated table
insights.evidence: src/radar.ts:20 imports computeSignals from signals.ts, line 25 imports StrategyEngine from analysis/engine.ts — both run in parallel per ticker loop; .prism-history.md Entry 1 Finding #6 documents this as partial fix (documented divergence but no consolidation)

insights.topic: Remaining as any casts in production source — blocked P0 target references nonexistent file
insights.suggestion: Fix webhook.ts:36 by typing the loadConfig return with webhooks in the RadarConfig interface, and either remove the plugin-entry.ts reference or create the file; fix binance.ts:187 and :202 by casting to the proper return types
insights.evidence: src/core/webhook.ts:36 uses (config as any).webhooks; src/binance.ts:187 and :202 both return (await res.json()) as any; search for plugin-entry.ts returns zero results — card t_112b666a targets a file that doesn't exist in the current codebase

insights.topic: Post-clamp multiplicative boost layer added but only on-chain and agreement bonus use it — volumeAdj and penalty still pre-clamp
insights.suggestion: Consider whether volumeAdj (pre-clamp at line 682) and other penalty paths should also be candidates for the post-clamp layer for architectural consistency
insights.evidence: src/signals.ts:689 clamp(compositeScore, 0, 100), then lines 697-705 apply onchainBoost and agreement bonus as multiplicative post-clamp boosts; penalty and volumeAdj are applied pre-clamp at lines 677-682

insights.topic: Paper trade multi-profile system is partially stubbed but blocked — profileName field exists but profile switching/management is unimplemented
insights.suggestion: Implement PaperTraderConfig.profileName-based persistence routing (dataDir/profileName/) and a management CLI to list/switch profiles
insights.evidence: src/paper-trade.ts:42-43 defines profileName: string with default 'trader1' but card t_0492fc42 (WS1 multi-profile system) remains dev-blocked; no profile CRUD or switching logic beyond the config field

insights.topic: News word-boundary matching uses space-delimited heuristics instead of regex \b — partial token collisions possible
insights.suggestion: Replace space-delimited matching with a proper \b word-boundary regex to avoid matching substrings (e.g., 'SOL' inside 'SOLVE')
insights.evidence: src/news.ts:305 uses desc.includes(' $' + sym) / desc.includes(' ' + sym.toUpperCase() + ' ') as proxy word-boundary checks — no \b usage; card t_8e786cb9 (WS5 word-boundary regex + Solana feeds) is marked done, suggesting these heuristics are the 'fix' rather than a true \b approach

insights.topic: tsconfig strict mode enabled but noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters are suppressed due to 40+ pre-existing unused declarations
insights.suggestion: Audit and remove unused declarations across the 12+ source files, then enable noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters as CI gates
insights.evidence: CHANGELOG.md lines 112-113 and lines 129-130 document that noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters are kept at false due to '40+ unused declarations across source tree' and '12 source files' with pre-existing tech debt

insights.topic: Prism scan revealed conservation law in additive scoring — post-clamp multiplicative layer is the engineered workaround but is only partially applied
insights.suggestion: Extend the post-clamp multiplicative layer to all boost types (not just on-chain and agreement bonus) for uniform behavior, or document why penalty/volume stay pre-clamp
insights.evidence: .prism-history.md lines 25-28 document the conservation law: 'additive scoring...under a final clamp, convert legitimate rewards into no-ops while letting penalties through'; fixed in signals.ts:691-705 but only for onchainBoost and agreement bonus penalty > 0

insights.topic: 8 blocked cards with a 3:5 qa:dev split — QA is holding two cards despite no active prism findings on QA infra
insights.suggestion: Unblock QA by either (a) running the verification tests flagged in t_dbc4d817 and t_d2734055, or (b) reclassifying them as dev-blocked if the underlying code is incomplete
insights.evidence: Blocked cards: 2 QA-blocked (t_dbc4d817 WS1 QA, t_d2734055 WS5 QA) vs 6 dev-blocked; health history shows STABLE at health=100 with 0 red stalls, suggesting no systemic fire-drill that would justify keeping QA blocked

insights.topic: Circuit breaker and network resilience path was explicitly excluded from prism scan — no verification of NaN/infinity handling under partial Binance outage
insights.suggestion: Schedule a follow-up prism scan focused on network resilience: verify that safeParseFloat and NaN guards in enrichTicker actually protect against a partial Binance outage producing null/NaN ticker fields
insights.evidence: .prism-history.md lines 12-13 and lines 32-33 document that 'network/resilience & rate-limit behavior (binance.ts, core/circuit-breaker.ts)' was sacrificed; src/core/circuit-breaker.ts exists but its interaction with enrichTicker safeParseFloat (radar.ts:73-76) under failure is unverified

insights.topic: Stall thresholds are all at defaults (green=2h, yellow=6h, red=6h) — red and yellow are identical, making red effectively unreachable
insights.suggestion: Tune stall thresholds: e.g., green=4h, yellow=12h, red=24h — the current defaults mean a card can never progress past yellow to red, masking truly stalled work
insights.evidence: Context reports stall thresholds as 'green=2h, yellow=6h, red=6h (defaults)' — yellow and red are the same value, so red stalls are mathematically impossible under normal conditions, which aligns with '0 red stalls' in health history
